3820.title: Provider bridge validation diagnostics and response contracts
3820.rootCauseOneLine: A malformed delta rejects its entire notification before assembly; actual runtime and persisted server state retain the active turn until valid completion is delivered separately.
3820.proposedFix: Add bounded validation diagnostics and correct wire examples; separately reproduce worker ownership across reload.
3820.caveats: 2026-09-30: two clean same-SHA runs passed 68 tests each after frozen install and normal server build. Mixed-first/last, split and all-valid controls extend evidence into runtime state and migrated server persistence. Production transport, UI, worker leak/RAM and historical documentation findings remain outside this verification.
